user_later_purchase_flag.name: user_later_purchase_flag
user_later_purchase_flag.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(s.fullVisitorId AS STRING) AS visitor_id,
  s.visitStartTime AS later_session_visit_start_time,
  -- Flag whether this session contains any purchase (transactionRevenue > 0 in hits.transaction or hits.item)
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
    WHERE
      -- transaction revenue recorded at hit.transaction.transactionRevenue (INT64) OR item-level itemRevenue
      (SAFE_CAST(h.transaction.transactionRevenue AS INT64) IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(h.transaction.transactionRevenue AS INT64) > 0)
      OR
      (SAFE_CAST(h.item.itemRevenue AS INT64) IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(h.item.itemRevenue AS INT64) > 0)
  ) AS later_session_has_purchase
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170127` AS s
-- Lift reference visitStartTime/visitor filtering out of the view: include all sessions for all visitors.
-- The consumer can JOIN/WHERE to compare later_session_visit_start_time against their reference visitStartTime per visitor.
grain: one row per visitor per session from the source table
user_later_purchase_flag.description: Per-user aggregation that indicates whether the user had any purchase in sessions strictly after a provided reference visitStartTime. Does not hard-code the reference; returns candidate session visitStartTimes and purchase flags to allow comparing to first_session_start externally.

questions_base.name: questions_base
questions_base.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS question_id,
  title,
  body,
  -- compute trimmed body length in characters; treat NULL as 0
  IFNULL(CHAR_LENGTH(body), 0) AS body_length,
  -- accepted_answer_id may be NULL; keep as INT64 when possible else NULL
  SAFE_CAST(accepted_answer_id AS INT64) AS accepted_answer_id,
  -- view_count in this dataset is INT64 (per posts_questions); use SAFE_CAST to be robust
  SAFE_CAST(view_count AS INT64) AS view_count,
  owner_user_id,
  -- parent_id is STRING in some tables; keep as STRING to preserve original; cast if numeric needed downstream
  parent_id,
  creation_date,
  SAFE_CAST(score AS INT64) AS score,
  -- answer_count may be INT64; cast safely
  SAFE_CAST(answer_count AS INT64) AS answer_count
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
questions_base.description: Canonical projection of question posts with cleaned numeric casts and computed body length. One row per question post.

answers_base.name: answers_base
answers_base.body_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(a.id AS INT64) AS answer_id,
  CAST(a.parent_id AS INT64) AS parent_question_id,
  CAST(a.score AS INT64) AS score,
  a.owner_user_id AS owner_user_id,
  a.creation_date AS creation_date
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` AS a
WHERE a.id IS NOT NULL
answers_base.description: Canonical projection of answer posts with numeric casts relevant for scoring and join keys. One row per answer post.

users_with_badges_and_netvotes.name: users_with_badges_and_netvotes
users_with_badges_and_netvotes.body_sql:
SELECT
  u.id AS user_id,
  u.display_name AS display_name,
  u.reputation AS reputation,
  u.up_votes AS up_votes,
  u.down_votes AS down_votes,
  (SAFE_CAST(u.up_votes AS INT64) - SAFE_CAST(u.down_votes AS INT64)) AS net_votes,
  IFNULL(b.badge_count, 0) AS badge_count
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` AS u
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    COUNT(*) AS badge_count
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.badges`
  GROUP BY
    user_id
) AS b
ON u.id = b.user_id
users_with_badges_and_netvotes.description: User-level profile with reputation, net votes (up_votes - down_votes) and total badge count. One row per user.
